# Hashtag Web3 — Documentation & Guides

> Scoped documentation index for developers, job seekers, and AI assistants accessing Hashtag Web3 documentation and career guides.

## Documentation Surfaces

- [Developer Portal](https://hashtagweb3.com/developers): Complete API documentation, curl examples, and authentication workflows.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://hashtagweb3.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 schema.
- [MCP Server Card](https://hashtagweb3.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol integration guide.
- [Agent Authentication](https://hashtagweb3.com/auth.md): WorkOS auth.md compliant agent identity specification.
- [Web3 Career Playbook](https://hashtagweb3.com/blog): 700+ articles on smart contracts, DeFi, zero-knowledge, and remote work.
- [Web3 Glossary](https://hashtagweb3.com/glossary): 200+ blockchain, cryptography, and protocol definitions.
